name: Default
shortDescription: Web interface and API that turns predefined shell commands into buttons, with login required and an editable config file.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated OLIVETIN_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment settings. Actions are defined in the config.yaml mount: edit it and redeploy, since it overwrites /config/config.yaml on every deploy. Commands run inside the container, with no access to the host or its Docker daemon.
